chunks: And the Prophet of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
They said: "O Messenger of Allah, and what are the gardens of Paradise?"

key_terms.بَادِرُوا: hasten; go quickly and eagerly toward something good
key_terms.حَلَقُ الذِّكْرِ: circles or gatherings in which Allah is remembered
key_terms.رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ: the gardens of Paradise, used here as a metaphor for a spiritually blessed setting

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله mean by the gardens of Paradise?
ai.summary: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said to hasten toward the "gardens of Paradise," then explained that these are the gatherings of dhikr. The hadith highlights the spiritual rank of assemblies in which Allah is remembered and encourages believers to seek them out eagerly.
